full_image_attempt.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / faithful high-resolution reconstruction.
The attached image is the approved character-selection artwork, originally 1586 × 992. Reconstruct this SAME image at a native output canvas of EXACTLY 3840 × 2400 pixels, 16:10 landscape, with newly resolved fine painted detail rather than plain interpolation, sharpening, or a re-composed picture. The intended use is a full-screen game background viewed on a 2560 × 1600 monitor.

Preservation is the highest priority. Keep the current framing, complete figure scale, pose and all element placements EXACTLY aligned to the reference: the young Chinese male deity floats on the RIGHT, arms gently down and out, hands open, two feet pointing downward above the bottom margin. Keep the left half as dark indigo quiet atmospheric space for UI text. Keep the complete circular near-black moon behind his head at exactly its current location and size, the gold sun mark on his forehead, the vast distant tree on the upper right, and the same blue-black cloud and star distribution. Do not enlarge the man, moon or robe, and do not crop the top, sides or feet.

Improve faithful high-resolution painted clarity where the original lacks samples: coherent eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth and hair strands; five anatomically connected natural fingers on each hand; continuous wrists and forearms; clean boundaries and broad folds in the starwoven robe; legible woven silver-blue and restrained gold embroidery; crisp tiny stars integrated into the cloth. Resolve cloth detail following the existing shapes, without inventing ornaments, new ribbons, new body parts or extra elements. Preserve the person's identity and expression, costume design, painterly material, subdued background, pose and light direction. The robe remains physical fabric, the moon remains an opaque extremely dark full disc with subtle uneven black tonal patterns, and the forehead sun remains a small gold mark.

Keep the existing Eastern mythology semi-realistic hand-painted game-illustration style. Maintain the current palette, atmosphere, contrast and value hierarchy. Face and robe detail should be readable without exaggerated sharpening, bright halos, hard black outlines, oversaturated color, noisy texture, new mystical effects, photorealistic skin or a glossy 3D appearance. Do not enhance the calm left background into distracting detail.

Output ONLY one faithful complete high-resolution landscape image, requested native size 3840 × 2400. No text, UI, borders, watermark, panels, split comparisons or thumbnails. Treat this as detail reconstruction of the existing accepted artwork, not a new interpretation.
